props.gloss_en: the mishna: an incident -- they decreed a fast in Lod [and when rain fell they ate and drank, and afterwards recited Hallel]
because one does not say Hallel except on a sated soul and a full belly
Rav Pappa came to the synagogue of Avi Govar and decreed a fast, and rain fell for them until midday
and he said to them: say Hallel, and afterwards eat and drink
the people of Mechoza are different, for drunkenness is common among them
